caseName: Donovan v. San Antonio Metropolitan Transit Authority
caseNameFull: Donovan, Secretary of Labor v. San Antonio Metropolitan Transit Authority and Garcia v. San Antonio Metropolitan Transit Authority

opinions.text:
Appeals from D. C. W. D. Tex. Judgment vacated and cases remanded for further consideration in light of Transportation Union v. Long Island R. Co., 455 U. S. 678 (1982).

Justice Brennan, Justice White, and Justice Marshall would note probable jurisdiction and set cases for oral argument.
